name: tingsvad-website
description: tingsvad.dk – the site itself. No dependencies: the scripts need only Node (bundles, _headers) and Python 3 (case register, ?v= hashes).

scripts.prep: python3 sagsregister.py && node tools/headers.mjs && node tools/bundt.mjs && sh bump.sh
scripts.prep:tjek: python3 sagsregister.py --tjek && node tools/headers.mjs --tjek && node tools/bundt.mjs --tjek
scripts.test: cd site-worker && npm test && cd ../worker && npm test && cd ../mcp && npm test
